notes: Holdout set: held out from ordinary skill editing. These cases are NOT near any skill's evals/evals.json and are invoked separately to test generalization beyond the development cases. Open repository: not secret, only workflow-separated.

cases.prompt: This change adds a JWT scope check to the auth middleware. Don't do a broad security audit - I only need to know whether the implementation is correct and mergeable.
cases.notes: Security vocabulary (JWT, scope) must not override the explicit deliverable: a merge-readiness correctness verdict on one diff.

cases.prompt: The checkout flow sometimes double-charges. Before we change anything, trace where the invariant was violated.
cases.notes: Debugging vocabulary in a payment context. The dominant job is root-cause diagnosis.

cases.prompt: Our user-service modules have become tangled and every change touches the same five files. Review the current shape and tell me whether we should restructure.
cases.notes: Pair A: deciding WHAT to do. Paired case flips to implementation-planning.

cases.prompt: We've decided to restructure the user-service modules. Work out the safest sequence of changes, intermediate states, and verification steps.
cases.notes: Pair B: executing an already-approved direction. One intent change flips the owner.
